Earnings Call (Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026) 
Dear Sir, 
In compliance with the Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, 
we hereby inform you that SRF Limited will participate in an investor and analyst conference call on Thursday, 
October 22, 2026 at 12:00 Noon IST.  This call will be hosted by DAM Capital Advisors Limited. 
 
Mr. Samir Kashyap – President & Chief Financial Officer and Ms. Sugandha Singhal – Senior Vice President – Head 
Treasury & Investor Relations will represent SRF on the call.  The conference call will be initiated with a brief 
management discussion on the Q2 & H1 FY27 results which will be declared on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, 
followed by an interactive Question & Answer session.
